success.description: 4 You find an appropriate gift, one that certainly endear you to the target. You influence the target.
As above, and you and the target recover 1 stress truly, giving is its own reward!

boon.description: The thought that counts, and your thought shows. Gain {Df} to your next Social action against the target.

sigmarsComet.description: You find the perfect gift, but it exceeds your budget. You may spend another {Dc} and gain +1 to your next attempt to influence the target.

conservative.requirements: A few hours of shopping in a commercial district of the target’s social tier. You spend S coins of the target’s social tier, then present the gift to the target. LxM is the final arbiter.

success.description: 4 You find an appropriate gift, one that will certainly endear you to the target. You influence the target.
Gain +1 to your next Social action against the target.

boon.description: The thought that counts, and your thought shows. Gain +1 to your next Social action against the target.

bane.description: You match the target’s tastes perfectly... and get him something he already has.

sigmarsComet.description: What luck! Your thoughtful generosity is observed by more than just the target; you may influence a second target of your choice.

reckless.requirements: A few hours of shopping in a commercial district of the target’s social tier. You spend 5 coins of the target’s social tier, then present the gift to the target. Special: You can’t play the same target with gifts more than about once a week. Your GM is the final arbiter.
